capabilities: Edit any transcluded embed's source in a floating panel on click
Support note, heading, and block-reference transclusions
Save or cancel edits with keyboard shortcuts and an unsaved-changes indicator
Link from the editor header to the source file path
Ship an optional CSS snippet for seamless embed styling
extras: Includes an optional seamless-embeds.css snippet bundled with the plugin; manual installation only; the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Editing content shown via Obsidian transclusion requires navigating to the source file first, breaking the workflow of the note you are working in.
summary: Click-to-edit transclusions: opens a floating panel to edit the source of any ![[note]] embed in place, syncing all embeds instantly.
